data.description: PIA Holding Company Limited (the Company) was incorporated in Pakistan under the Company's Act, 2017 (the Act) on 21 March 2024 and listed on Pakistan Stock Exchange on 27 May 2024. The principal activity of the Company is to act as the holding company of its subsidiaries and associates.
